d: Android to PS Vita port of Snail Mail
ld: This repository contains a **wrapper/loader** for the Android release of Snail Mail, running native ARM dynamic libraries (`.so`) on the PlayStation Vita via TheFloW's Android SO Loader architecture, FalsoJNI, and vitaGL.
req:
- Updating from previous versions (v01.00 / v01.01 / v01.02): install the new snailmail.vpk with VitaShell. Your existing data files and saves in ux0:data/snailmail/ are kept.
- Copy lib/armeabi-v7a/libsnailmail.so (or lib/armeabi/libsnailmail.so) to ux0:data/snailmail/libsnailmail.so.
- Copy assets/asm.mp3 to ux0:data/snailmail/assets/asm.mp3.
- Copy all 118 .ogg audio files from assets/ to ux0:data/snailmail/assets/.
- > Game files are never distributed. You always need your own legally obtained copy of the game.
